tone: Use clear, concise Polish with neutral impersonal software phrasing.
capitalization: Use sentence case and Polish capitalization rules, not English title case.
button_labels: Use short conventional infinitive action labels without final periods.
ui_roles: Keep menu and setting labels as concise noun phrases, buttons as infinitive actions, tooltips explanatory, and errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Use established Polish software terms and preserve glossary tokens verbatim.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from feature context: input may mean sterowanie, sygnał, or wejście; binding means przypisanie; capture varies by media or control detection; overlay is nakładka; replay is not automatically odtwarzanie.
punctuation: Use Polish quotation and punctuation conventions while retaining accelerators.
units: Use metric conventions, comma decimals where applicable, and proper unit spacing.
natural_language: Use idiomatic Polish syntax and avoid literal English calques.
